source_of_truth: human actions requiring an explicit decision, observation, or authority

actions.action: Run the predeclared Proof Tiles human experiment
actions.why_human_required: Learning transfer, adult rescue, repeat use, and payment require real participants.
actions.required_input_or_decision: Recruit an admissible homeschooling parent and obtain consent.
actions.resume_condition: Ingest a signed external result with python3 scripts/ingest-education-result.py.
actions.expiry_condition: Participant context is no longer current or consent expires.

actions.action: Confirm Product A shelved/archive disposition through the owner-authorized repository lifecycle path
actions.why_human_required: Repository archive state, lifecycle, and destructive/archive operations are owner-controlled.
actions.blocked_work: Product A archive eligibility only; no product implementation
actions.required_input_or_decision: Authorize or decline the external lifecycle operation; do not authorize resumption by implication.
actions.resume_condition: Portfolio metadata and remote lifecycle evidence agree.

actions.action: Review Apple identity, metadata, and release authority for an explicitly selected product
actions.why_human_required: App Store Connect submission and release are human-authorized and external.
actions.blocked_work: Apple distribution readiness and any TestFlight/App Review submission
actions.required_input_or_decision: Select the intended public identity and approve no submission; submission remains outside factory authority.
actions.resume_condition: A reviewed product manifest records the decision and evidence level.
actions.expiry_condition: Apple metadata or product archive changes.

actions.action: Review the next bounded historical archaeology batch
actions.why_human_required: Identity, IP, and preservation value can remain ambiguous after metadata-only triage.
actions.blocked_work: Deep extraction for selected historical candidates
actions.required_input_or_decision: Approve the selected candidates and preservation scope; no deletion authorization is implied.
actions.resume_condition: The bounded batch has a completed knowledge record or an explicit UNKNOWN disposition.

actions.action: Run the predeclared Side-by-Side Spark observation
actions.why_human_required: Real homework interaction change and child independence require observation and consent.
actions.required_input_or_decision: Recruit an admissible family and obtain consent.

actions.action: Run the predeclared Misconception Lens workflow observation
actions.why_human_required: Teacher workflow burden, anonymized artifacts, action change, and paid-pilot behavior require educators.
actions.required_input_or_decision: Recruit educators and obtain permission for anonymized artifacts.
actions.resume_condition: Ingest an admissible external result with privacy review.
actions.expiry_condition: School term, artifact permission, or workflow context changes.
